scope: One brush stamp on a fixed world revision; terrain-only numeric result

intent.worldPoint: finite x/y from the active camera transform; declared web world coordinate system
intent.radius: finite positive value in web world units; not CSS pixels and not claimed to reproduce original camera/radius mapping
intent.heightInput: finite float32 control value; interpreted by the recovered mode, not generic opacity
intent.decayFactor: explicit finite float32 Hill exponent; original runtime UI limits unknown
intent.randomInput: declared algorithm/version/state or explicit finite tape; replayable web adaptation, not recovered Unity state

selection.authority: Resolve against the same immutable geometry revision used for display and command confirmation
selection.preferredWebDefinition: Containing-polygon center pick plus circle/polygon intersection selection
selection.nativeDefinition: Raycast CellObject.Site.CellIndex center plus Physics.OverlapSphere collider selection
selection.neighbors: Use stored ordered adjacency without sorting or re-triangulating during the command
selection.noCenterHit: Explicit no-op; do not silently choose a remote nearest sample
selection.centerMembership: Native Hill kernel allows center outside selected; UI adapter may enforce a stricter declared contract

numericRules.hillReplaceErase: Not covered by the Plane erase finding; reject or explicitly adapt unsupported combinations
numericRules.overflowAndInvalidInputs: Reject or use an explicitly documented adaptation; do not claim arbitrary JavaScript arithmetic matches native int32 overflow

result.purpose: Render, undo, save and restore from the same real elevation state
result.previewConfirm: Bind revision, selection algorithm, control values and RNG input; reject stale confirmation

originalRuntimeDefaults.height: Unverified active binding; scene candidate min 0 / max 100 / default 45 recorded separately
originalRuntimeDefaults.radius: Unverified active binding; two scene candidates have different defaults
